verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. May the LORD answer you when trouble hits. May the name of Jacob's God lift you to safety,
send help from his sanctuary, and back you up from Zion.
May he remember everything you've offered and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
May he give you what your heart longs for and bring all your plans to life.
We'll cheer when he rescues you and raise our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant every request you make. 🙌
Now I know the LORD saves his anointed. He'll answer him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.
Some put their trust in chariots, others in horses. We trust in the name of the LORD our God.
They buckle and fall, but we rise and stand tall.
Save us, LORD! May the King answer when we call!
